title: Get the reference
description: Returns the product's reference: its stages, then its kinds in stage order with the product's own after Lathe's, its tables by role, its relations, every check (Lathe's in run order, the engine's own, then the product's) and the coverage gaps.

title: Get a record with its links
description: Returns one record by its ID: its kind and label, its row, its parent and the product, domain and aggregate it sits in, its part rows by table, the records under it by kind and ID, and its links out and in, each read by its relation's label. An ID no record has is refused.

title: List a kind's records
description: Returns the rows of one stored table in key order, or only those under a parent: records whose parent column names it, records of a kind with no owner in that product or domain, the part rows it owns, or the links that start or end at it. A table that does not exist, or a parent for rows that have none, is refused.

title: Get the next ID
description: Returns the next free ID for a record of a kind under the given parent, or, for a kind with no owner, under the product or domain its ID starts with, as the Next ID service works it out; a flow's ID takes the number of the first interface its use case has no flow through. A parent of the wrong kind, a product, a kind whose ID ends in a name the writer chooses, and a one-per-parent ID that is taken are refused.

title: Find a record's data file
description: Returns the path of the data file that holds the record with the given ID, from the data folders of every product in the workspace, or nothing when no file holds it.

title: Get a use case whole
description: Returns the use case that holds a record, by the use case's ID or that of any requirement, flow, step or test in it, whole as its page shows it, with the record asked for and its kind.

title: List a capability's use cases
description: Returns the use cases of one capability, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a use case
description: Returns the next free ID for a use case, UC requirement, use case test, flow, flow step or flow test under its parent: one past the highest in use, a flow's ending in the number of the first interface it has no flow through yet.

title: Get a product whole
description: Reads a product whole, by its ID, the ID of an open question or interface in it, or the name of a kind it declares: its row, roles, declared kinds with their fields, relations, open questions with what they are about, and interfaces.

title: List a product's interfaces
description: Lists the interfaces of a product, by ID, with their titles and kinds.

title: Get the next ID in a product
description: The next free ID for an open question (under a product or a domain) or an interface (under a product): one past the highest in use.

title: List the products
description: Lists every product, by ID, with its title, and its icon and color when it gives them: the spaces the app's nav lists.

title: Get a business outcome
description: Reads a business outcome whole, by its ID: its statement, measure and target, and the tests and records that measure it.

title: List a product's business outcomes
description: Lists the business outcomes of a product, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next business outcome ID
description: The next free ID for a business outcome of a product: one past the highest in use.

title: Get an extension record
description: Reads a record of a product's own kind whole: its kind, its row, the links it starts by relation, and the packages it uses.

title: List a parent's extension records of a kind
description: Lists the records of a product kind under one parent, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get an entry point
description: Reads an entry point whole, by its ID: its row, the packages it uses and the standard rules it meets.

title: List a domain's entry points
description: Lists the entry points of a domain, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next entry point ID
description: The next free ID for an entry point of a domain: one past the highest in use.

title: Get a tooling record
description: Reads a tooling record whole, by its ID: its row, the packages it uses and the standard rules it meets.

title: List a domain's tooling
description: Lists the tooling records of a domain, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next tooling ID
description: The next free ID for a tooling record of a domain: one past the highest in use.

title: Get the next extension record ID
description: The next free ID for a record of a product kind under its parent, by the kind's declared ID pattern: one past the highest in use.

title: Get a domain whole
description: Reads a domain whole as its page shows it, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: the record asked for and its kind, the domain's row, its capabilities in order with the outcomes they serve and their use cases, its terms, its domain services with their services and tests, and its repositories with the aggregates they persist.

title: List a product's domains
description: Lists the domains of a product, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a domain
description: The next free ID for a capability, term, domain service or repository (under a domain), or a service or domain service test (under a domain service): one past the highest in use.

title: Get a test data set whole
description: Reads a test data set whole as its page shows it, by its ID: its environment, accounts and records, how to prepare and reset it, the file that builds it, and the tests that start from it.

title: List a domain's test data sets
description: Lists the test data sets of a domain, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next test data set ID
description: The next free ID for a test data set of a domain: one past the highest in use.

title: Get a pattern whole
description: Reads a pattern whole as its page shows it, by its ID or the ID of any rule or rule test in it: the record asked for and its kind, the pattern's row, its settings in order, and its rules by ID, each with its tests (with the test data sets they start from).

title: List a product's patterns
description: Lists the patterns of a product, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a pattern
description: The next free ID for a pattern rule (under a pattern) or a pattern rule test (under a rule): one past the highest in use.

title: Get a standard whole
description: Reads a standard whole as its page shows it, by its ID or the ID of any rule or rule test in it: the record asked for and its kind, the standard's row, and its rules by ID, each with the records that meet it and its tests (with the test data sets they start from).

title: List a product's standards
description: Lists the standards of a product, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a standard
description: The next free ID for a standard rule (under a standard) or a standard rule test (under a rule): one past the highest in use.

title: Get an aggregate whole
description: Reads an aggregate whole, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: its row, its entities with their fields and the entities they hold, their data models, and its invariants with their tests.

title: List a domain's aggregates
description: Lists the aggregates of a domain, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in an aggregate
description: The next free ID for an aggregate (under a domain), an entity or invariant (under an aggregate), a data model (under an entity) or an invariant test (under an invariant): one past the highest in use.

title: Get a domain event whole
description: Reads a domain event whole, by its ID or its event type's: its row, the fields it carries in order, and its event type with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: List an aggregate's domain events
description: Lists the domain events that happen to an aggregate, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a domain event
description: The next free ID for a domain event (under an aggregate) or its event type (under the event): one past the highest in use.

title: Get a command whole
description: Reads a command whole, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: its row, the events it raises, the specifications it checks and the domain services it calls, its handler, and its policies with the event each hears, their event handlers and tests.

title: List an entity's commands
description: Lists the commands that change an entity, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a command
description: The next free ID for a command (under an entity), a command handler or policy (under a command), or an event handler or policy test (under a policy): one past the highest in use.

title: Get a specification whole
description: Reads a specification whole as its page shows it, by its ID or the ID of its predicate or test: the record asked for and its kind, the specification's row and the domain its ID names, the aggregates it reads, its predicate with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses, and its test with the test data sets it starts from.

title: List a domain's specifications
description: Lists the specifications of a domain (those whose ID names it), by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a specification
description: The next free ID for a specification (under its domain: one past the highest in use), or the one ID of a predicate or specification test (under its specification).

title: Get a value object whole
description: Reads a value object whole as its page shows it, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: the record asked for and its kind, the value object's row and the product its ID names, its fields in order, its constraints by ID each with its test (and the test data sets it starts from), and its value type with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: List a product's value objects
description: Lists the value objects of a product (those whose ID names it), by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a value object
description: The next free ID for a value object (under its product) or a constraint (under its value object): one past the highest in use; or the one ID of a value type (under its value object) or a constraint test (under its constraint).

title: Get a read model whole
description: Reads a read model whole as its page shows it, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: the record asked for and its kind, the read model's row and fields in order, what it reads, calls and is fed by, its queries by ID each with what it selects by and calls and its handler, its projection and its reader (each piece of code with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses).

title: List a domain's read models
description: Lists the read models of a domain, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a read model
description: The next free ID for a read model (under its domain) or a query (under its read model): one past the highest in use; or the one ID of a projection or a reader (under its read model) or a query handler (under its query).

title: Get a table whole
description: Reads a table whole as its page shows it, by its ID: its row, the entity, read model or domain it sits under, its keys in order, the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: List the tables under a record
description: Lists the tables under an entity, a read model or a domain, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next table ID
description: The next free ID for a table: the one ID of an entity's or read model's table, or a domain's next own table, one past the highest in use.

title: Get a view whole
description: Reads a view whole, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: its row, and its view requirements with their tests.

title: List a product's views
description: Lists the views of a product, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in a view
description: The next free ID for a view (under a product), a view requirement (under a view) or a view test (under a view requirement): one past the highest in use.

title: Get an endpoint whole
description: Reads an endpoint whole, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: its row, its API requirements with their tests, and its handler.

title: List the endpoints of a command or query
description: Lists the endpoints that expose a command or query, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in an endpoint
description: The next free ID for an endpoint (under a command or query), an API requirement or endpoint handler (under an endpoint) or an endpoint test (under an API requirement): one past the highest in use.

title: Get an integration whole
description: Reads an integration whole, by its ID or the ID of any record in it: its row, its adapter and its integration tests.

title: List a product's integrations
description: Lists the integrations of a product, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID in an integration
description: The next free ID for an integration (under a product), or an adapter or integration test (under an integration): one past the highest in use.

title: Get a UI component whole
description: Reads a UI component whole: its row, the views it renders, the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses.

title: List a product's UI components
description: Lists the UI components of a product, by ID, with their titles.

title: Get the next ID for a UI component
description: The next free ID for a UI component of a product: one past the highest in use.

title: Get the workspace's problems
description: one load of the product's data, then every problem: `data-refused` errors when the store refuses the data (and nothing else), else Lathe's checks then each product's, in DS01's order, a product's check reporting only on records of its product. `lathe check`, the MCP `check` tool and `GET /api/spec` all read it.

title: List a product's problems
description: one product's problems, errors before warnings, grouped by check, then the problems that belong to no product under Workspace.

title: Get the error count of the product in front
description: the number of errors of the focused window's space, its product's and the workspace's, as its Checks panel counts them.

title: Get a check whole
description: Reads a check row whole, by its name: its product, place in the run order, severity, summary, explanation, query and kinds.

title: List the checks that run on a product
description: Lists the checks that run on a product, Lathe's first and then the product's own, each in its run order, with its severity and summary.

title: Get the product's limits
description: Reads a product's limits: the most children of one kind a record should hold and the most entities an aggregate should hold, its own or the defaults.

title: Get a record
description: A record's page from its space's index: its title, ID, product, domain and kind, its text, its kind's own sections (a flow's steps, an aggregate's events, a pattern's or standard's rules), its traceability, its children, its problems, and its facts with its links both ways grouped by label; an ID no record has gives a not-found note.

title: Find a record
description: The records, kinds and checks of the current space whose ID or title holds the typed text, best first (exact ID, ID prefix, title prefix, a title word's prefix, then anywhere), ties in ID order, twenty at most.

title: List a space's problems
description: The current space's problems grouped by check, errors first: the product's own, then the workspace's (those that belong to no product), with the count of errors and warnings, and the recorded exceptions after them.

title: Get a record's form
description: The form for editing a record or adding one of a kind: the kind's columns as typed fields, its parent as a choice among the records it may sit under in the same product, the links it may start with their valid targets, and the part rows it owns, filled from the record, or empty with a suggested ID.

title: Get the nav
description: The current space's nav tree: Shared with what the product shares, then each domain in ID order with its stages and open questions; in each stage one folder per kind in the schema's order (or the records themselves when it holds one kind), each with its count, empty ones left out, listing the records that start a branch of the stage, capabilities by position and the rest by ID.

title: Get a domain
description: A domain's page: its text, its records under its stages and kind folders as the nav lays them out (filtered by the page's search), the patterns it follows, any of its records no folder lists, its open questions, its coverage with its gaps, and the problems under it.

title: Get a group
description: A group's page: the record it belongs to, its kind with the kind's description (or its stage's), and its members, one list per kind when it holds several kinds, each member with its own children folded.

title: Get a focus's frame
description: The picture the camera frames around a record or group on its product's graph map: its parent, the focus and its descendants down to the chosen depth, leaving out hidden kinds and anything reached only through them, each node with its column and row, and the parent lines between them.

title: Get the ERD map
description: A product's ERD map for a focus: every domain's region, aggregate boundary and entity with its fields, and the has-one, has-many and reference lines between them, with the scope the focus keeps at full strength (its domain, its aggregate or the whole product), the box it picks out, and how strongly every other box is drawn.

title: Get a record's history
description: The commits that changed a record's rows (its own row, the part rows it owns and the links it starts), newest first, twenty a page with whether older ones remain, each with its date, author, subject and every row added, removed or changed column by column, then its changes not committed yet; a folder outside git gets a calm `no-repo` answer instead.

title: List the spaces
description: Every product as a space, in product ID order, each with its icon or monogram, its color and its number of domains; the space the Reader was last in is marked, and each opens at the last page visited in it this session, else its product page.

title: Get what changed since a baseline
description: The records that differ between a product's baseline (the last commit, where the branch left the default branch, or a commit the app noted) and its data now, in ID order: each added, removed, or changed with its columns before and after, its part rows added, removed or changed, and the links it starts added and removed.

title: Get the workspace
description: Returns a product repo's workspace: every record with its parts, links and file facts, and the checks' problems and coverage. Data the store refuses returns no records and one data-refused error per refusal; a config for another schema version is refused.

title: Get the product's data
description: Returns the rows of every product the workspace shows, each product folder's apart, under one joined schema, with each product's problems, exceptions, coverage and chains. Refused when two folders hold the same product ID.

title: List the commands
description: Returns every keyboard command in the keymap's order, with its title, group and context and its bindings for the platform after the person's overrides, leaving out any binding that takes a browser essential.

title: List the themes
description: Returns the built-in themes, Lathe first, then the person's own, with the one in use (Lathe when the chosen one is gone), the color mode, and for a copy the built-in theme it came from.

title: Get a theme file
description: Returns a theme as its versioned file: format, version, name and its light, dark and other token values in a stable order, ready to save and share.

title: List the recent folders
description: Returns the recent folders, latest first, each shown from the home folder as `~`, as File › Open Recent lists them.

title: Get the data's changes as they happen
description: Tells an open page, as it happens, that the workspace it shows changed, so it loads the data again.

title: List a folder's Claude Code sessions
description: The window's folder's sessions, newest first, each by its name, summary or first prompt, with running or just written marked, and the `claude` the chat runs.

title: Get what the Reader is looking at
description: The MCP tool app_focus, and `lathe app focus` from a shell: the window's page, focus, stage and selection, named by ID, kind and title; refused when no window is connected.

title: Get the window's chat
description: The window's whole chat as one patch, for a page that loads or reloads; the patches that follow it come as the chat changes.

title: Get coverage counts
description: Workspace.coverage[].obligations and .proved_by (the tests that count as each obligation's proof there); lathe check's coverage lines; the product and domain pages

title: List coverage gaps
description: Coverage.gaps; the gap callouts and the not-designed, not-built and not-proved warnings

title: Get test counts by state
description: Returns one row per domain, and one per product for what lies outside every domain, with its tests counted as automated, manual and not automated yet, ordered by product then domain.

title: List the pattern rules a domain owes
description: Coverage.pattern_rules, each followed rule's standing per domain: Patterns we follow, the pattern and pattern rule pages, and Traceability's owing domains

title: Get a record's traceability
description: Returns what designs, builds and proves one record, grouped as Designed by, Built by (Met by, for a standard rule) and Proved by, then its other links under their labels; for a use case, its UC requirements, each judged, and for a test, what it proves and how it is run.

title: Get an obligation's trace
description: One obligation's traceability chain: what designs it, the technical records that build it, its tests and the files they name, with the gaps coverage reports for it (not designed, not built, not proved). The Trace stage draws it to the right of the obligation in its product's tree, and lists it column by column when the obligation is the focus.

title: Find the files that are missing or silent
description: The checks that read the file facts: a test's file missing or not naming it, a manual test's file naming it, and a technical record's file missing.

title: List routes traced both ways
description: route_facts (each endpoint's and view's route, and whether the files of what implements it name it) and served_routes (each route the code serves): the endpoint-route-not-in-file and view-route-not-in-file checks and the route-without-record gap.

title: Find the tables their files do not define
description: The table-schema-mismatch check, a query of table_facts.

title: Get a following whole
description: Reads a domain's or use case's following of a pattern whole: the value, or the reason it does not apply, it gives each of the pattern's settings.

title: List the patterns a follower follows
description: Lists the patterns a domain or use case follows, by ID.

title: Find the packages no record uses
description: The packages the product's package.json files list that no technical record names: one package-not-accounted-for gap per product.

title: List the obligations under a record
description: The Trace stage's table: every obligation under a record or group, grouped by its parent; or, for a record no obligation is under, the rows of the obligations whose chains hold it or the rows around it (traceShape).
